C12 and C24 share essentially the same formulation but are slightly less proximate in time.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Pennsylvania Railroad Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by ... labor organizations","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS a dispute exists between The Long Island Railroad Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by ... a labor organization","explanation":"The opening recital follows the same carrier-and-represented-employees template, with the disputing parties substituted."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service","explanation":"The two substantive predicates are virtually verbatim and appear in the same sequence."},{"child_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.","parent_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.","explanation":"The reporting mandate is identical."},{"child_excerpt":"As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Pennsylvania Railroad Company, or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose.","parent_excerpt":"As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by The Long Island Railroad Company, or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the dispute arose.","explanation":"The operative status-quo machinery is identical apart from substitution of the carrier."}]}
